# Codex Chat Auto Title v2

> Windows Codex new-chat auto rename / 聊天记录自动命名 / UserPromptSubmit hook / set_thread_title.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title
Community MIT project, not an official OpenAI product. Credits: NOTICE, study8677/rename.

- [Chinese](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/README.md)
- [English](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/README.en.md)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Validation](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md)
- [Legacy worker](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/docs/LEGACY.md)

Default V2: synchronous UserPromptSubmit hook injects rules once on a genuinely new first turn. Current model completes task, validates a local one-time permission and calls native set_thread_title before final reply. Format module|ongoing goal, <=24 Unicode code points. Follow-ups do not reinject. No worker, model switch, subagent or separate naming-model request; normal context/tool token overhead applies.

Install from full source: python -X utf8 manage.py install
Optional project scope: --project-root PATH. Requires Windows Python 3.11+, Codex Hooks and desktop set_thread_title. Human reviews/trusts Codex Chat Auto Title v2: first message only in Settings > Hooks.

Reads canonical current metadata/transcript only, bounded to 2 MiB. Skips historical/manual/ambiguous/pinned/archived/fork/subagent chats. Preflight protects manual title/project moves before claim; not atomic with native API, model compliance and UI ordering not guaranteed. Private runtime must not be shared.

Explicit legacy mode hook_queue retains Stop hook, SQLite queue, isolated CLI model, title-only transactional writes, optional startup and daily budget. It is not active alongside default V2.
